title: Three of Pennywell's central 'whose face' stakeholders — Averil (mint-warden), Dray (paymaster), and Meva (tithe-collector) — have no bespoke reaction to the final ruling ('strike the coin with the old king's face'). Asking them afterward returns only the default farewell line (Averil, Dray) or no new dialogue option at all (Meva), unlike Doran, Sarel, Slade, Robin, and Sergeant Wray, who each got a specific line about it. Averil in particular staked her whole warrant on this question.
where: The Counting-House / talk to Averil; Paymaster's Chest-Room / talk to Dray; The Tithe-House / talk to Meva (all post-'Pennywell's Coin')
